name: ZR2 Bioenergy Limited
summary: ZR2 Bioenergy Ltd. engages in the business of manufacturing industrial chemicals. It manufactures chemicals, including synthetic resins, sodium carboxy methyl cellulose, monochord acetic acid, industrial alcohol, acetaldehyde, and acetic acid. The company was founded on April 4, 1939 and is headquartered in Ahmedabad, India.
